title: Paged Catalog Lookup
brief: A product catalog keeps its item ids split into fixed-size pages. Within a page the ids increase, and every page starts with an id larger than the last id on the previous page. The storefront needs to check quickly whether an id is in the catalog.
Implement pagedIndexContains(matrix, target), where matrix is the list of pages, each a list of ids, and target is the id to look up, and return true if target is in the catalog and false otherwise.
